# Security Policy

## Supported version

Security fixes are provided for the current version on the `main` branch. Older commits and forks are not supported.

## Report a vulnerability privately

Do not disclose suspected vulnerabilities in public issues, discussions, pull requests, or other public channels. Use GitHub's [private vulnerability reporting form](https://github.com/himiyosh/encode-decode-tool/security/advisories/new) so the report can be assessed and coordinated through a private GitHub Security Advisory.

Include the affected URL, commit, or version; prerequisites and reproducible steps; expected and observed behavior; security and privacy impact; a minimal proof of concept; and any suggested mitigation. Remove real secrets, personal data, and other sensitive content from screenshots, logs, QR images, and sample inputs.

This tool is designed to process entered text and QR images locally in the browser. Reports about unexpected network transmission, exposure through browser storage or clipboard behavior, unsafe handling of decoded URLs or files, Content Security Policy bypasses, or other violations of that local-only privacy boundary are especially important.
